versions.changelog:
Short Video Script Generator skill initial release.

- Automatically generates ready-to-shoot short video scripts from just a topic and type (talking-head, drama, product-seeding, or science).
- Outputs a structured four-part script: catchy title, clear duration (30s/60s), detailed shot-by-shot storyboard (with four columns), and shooting tips.
- Every voiceover line is colloquial and ≤15 Chinese characters, with a strong suspense/conflict/counter-intuitive hook in the first 3 seconds.
- Defaults to "talking-head" and 30 seconds if type or duration is not specified.
- Designed for instant script creation with no further user prompts required.
